A good dynamic comes from two equals who genuinely listen to each other, not one person dialing themselves down to make things smoother. I'm always open to hearing where you're coming from and exploring ideas together, but my voice and my opinions are an essential part of who I am. If we disagree or see things differently, that's fine—it doesn't have to be tense, but it does have to be honest.
